description: This file defines the DecryptedItemMutator class, which extends ItemMutator to provide mutation operations for decrypted items, including setting content, metadata, relationships, and domain data.

classes.name: DecryptedItemMutator
classes.description: A class that manages mutations for decrypted items, allowing updates to content, metadata, relationships, and domain data.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the mutated payload, updating timestamps and dirty flags based on mutation type.

methods.name: setBeginSync
methods.description: Sets synchronization start information including last sync time and dirty index.

methods.name: setCustomContent
methods.description: Sets custom content for the item; usage is discouraged as it may break schema.

methods.name: userModifiedDate
methods.description: Setter that updates the userModifiedDate in app data.

methods.name: conflictOf
methods.description: Setter that updates the conflict_of field in mutable content.

methods.name: protected
methods.description: Setter that marks the item as protected.

methods.name: trashed
methods.description: Setter that marks the item as trashed.

methods.name: starred
methods.description: Setter that marks the item as starred.

methods.name: setDomainData
methods.description: Overwrites the entire domain data for a specified domain.

methods.name: setDomainDataKey
methods.description: Sets a specific key-value pair within a domain's data.

methods.name: setAppDataItem
methods.description: Sets an app data item in the default domain.

methods.name: e2ePendingRefactor_addItemAsRelationship
methods.description: Adds an item as a relationship reference if not already present.

methods.name: removeItemAsRelationship
methods.description: Removes an item from the relationships references.
